a_runs.energy_inclusion_rule_e206_e207: as data_v3.e206_style / e211-style: a run is kept when its host record equals the registered point (arm, type, minions, shire_mask) and t_gemm_s, p_work_w, p_rest_w and cycles_gemm are present; the point = the mean of its kept runs
a_runs.energy_inclusion_rule_e212: as data_v3.mms_runs: ran; role not null; values 'gemmL..:' and shires present; the primary view has T_op_us, cyc_op_max, n_launch >= 1; energy only when the view's dP_w is not None, p_mean_w is truthy, the run is not capped and its role is not 'time'

group_B_reported_phi_only.why: E206's fp32 real: its count is E210's committed 'real' row; MM1-v3's phi_of() had no rule

group_C_reported_sparse50.why: E212's gen-sparse50 arms (file = the lab's sparse50 tile as the pool's pair 0, the rest drawn by the sparse50 law): the committed sparse50 kind (the counts lane's reading); MM1-v3 read them for time only (data_v3 gives E212 pattern arms no energy)

a_runs.not_in_scope: every other E212 run (random, zeros, ones: priced and fitted by MM1-v3); E212 a2c0-S3 (never ran); E213 (no data file opened; v31-counts: no E213 point NOT FORECAST)
a_runs.references: for the share of D: E212, random and zeros runs at the same (arm, fmt, mask) in the same session (the same inclusion rule); E206 and E207, the random and zeros points at the same (arm, fmt, mask) in the same experiment arm. Without both, the run's share of D is NOT SCORED (said per run).

b_quantities.Q1_W_over_idle_given_t: each model's W over idle at the run's measured op time t_meas, as MM1-v3 README section 5: W = A + B / t_meas from the predictor called at the run's card, arm, format, kind (priced as declared), mask, clock f (E212: the primary view's kclock_mhz; E206/E207: 600 MHz, as data_v3), volts (aifoundry1 card 1: 0.517 V and aifoundry3: 0.522 V, data_v3's footings; aifoundry2 card 0 and aifoundry1 card 0: the primary view's minion mV / 1000, else volts(card, f)), governed base G_of_f(card, f), die = die_start_c (50 C when absent); t_meas = the primary view's T_op_us (E212). E206/E207 points: their conditions and readings exactly as MM1-v3's own loader records them (data_v3.energy_points(): f 600 MHz, the card footing's volts, G 0, t = mean cycles_gemm / ops / 600 MHz, w = mean(p_work_w - p_rest_w), idle = mean p_rest_w, die = the kept runs' mean die_start_c for E206 arm B and E207, and none (so 50 C) for E206 arm A, as MM1-v3 records every arm-A point). Error = W_fc / W_meas - 1 when W_meas >= 3 W (else the watts difference). W_meas: E212 the primary view's dP_w; E206/E207 the loader's w.
b_quantities.Q2_share_of_D: E210's registered metric: e_D = [(W_fc(P) - W_fc(R)) - (W_P - W_R)] / D, D = W_R - W_Z measured; W_R, W_Z the means of the in-session reference runs (points); W_fc(R) the same model's W given t at each reference run's own conditions, averaged. In % of D, signed.
b_quantities.Q3_J_at_rest_given_t_REPORTED: (P_rest + W_fc) / (P_rest + W_meas) - 1, P_rest the run's measured rest (E212 p_mean_w - dP_w; E206/E207 p_rest_w)
b_quantities.Q4_J_over_idle_t_forecast_REPORTED: W_fc(t_fc) t_fc / (W_meas t_meas) - 1 at W_meas >= 3 W, t_fc = MM1-v3's op time at the run's clock (the clock is an input)

c_metric.case: E212: (card, arm, fmt, kind, mask) over the listed sessions; its error = the mean of its runs' errors. E206/E207: the registered point (the mean of its kept runs) is the case.
c_metric.reported: rms % and signed mean %, per run and per case; per card, per format, per group (A, B, C), pooled; split by configuration twins (a case is a twin when its time configuration (card, kernel, arm, fmt, mask, clock to 25 MHz) is among MM1-v3's priced energy points (usable3, E146 rungs out) with another kind; every test kind is new to the energy fit by construction) and by whether an MM1-v3 design or spec lane tabulated the run's power (section g)

d_comparisons.N2_REPORTED: the same over the ungated counted kinds ones and random only (a stricter null for ungated patterns)
d_comparisons.N_null_pass_rule: each format's mean of the counted kinds on that card: W_N = the mean of MM1-v3's own W given t at the run's conditions over the kinds zeros, ones and random of the run's format (all three measured on every test configuration's card in E212 and priced by MM1-v3); the same base as V3, only the count's information differs
d_comparisons.V1_REPORTED: MM1-v1 as frozen (25d2e74e; tools/matmul/mm1/v1, 77/77 OK), its kind term where it applies: e_res and phi by its own kind_specs (blind_day_v1.kind_specs for E207: e37 ledger fp32.small_int, blind4 M6, blind3 M5; kinds_v1.e206_kind for E206 real: ledger v2 real2 rows), card footings as V3, W = A + B / t_meas; NOT FORECAST where its e_res has no source: every E212 run (no ledger row or frozen per-tile prediction for any plan tile or sparse50), E206 arm B (no card-1 real2 rows). Labels: E207 points blind for MM1-v1 (frozen before E207); E206 arm A points were in MM1-v1's own in-sample scoring (its README: 'E206's 6 real points scored, nothing fitted for the kind')
d_comparisons.V3: MM1-v3 as landed, its predictor unchanged, with the frozen counts added as data rows (E210C fp32 S1/S2, SWT fp16/int8) and phi by rule e
d_comparisons.V3_phi1_REPORTED: V3 with phi = 1 (random's) for every new kind: the weight of rule e

e_phi.rule: MM1-v3's own formula, kinds_v3.phi(fmt, spec), over each kind's tile files (one value a kind, S1 and S2 alike): E212 plan tiles their registered file; E206 real kinds_v3.e206_kind's four real2 files; E207 real:blind4 its two files, blind3 its one, e37 the generator 'e37'; tile sha256 checked against the registration or the counts rows. Group C: MM1-v3's own phi_of('sparse50'). Desk (tile bytes only).

f_pass_rule.P1: rms of V3's Q1 error < rms of N's Q1 error, over the group A cases with Q1 (W_meas >= 3 W)
f_pass_rule.P2: exact two-sided sign test on Q1 per case: d = |e_N| - |e_V3|; a tie when |d| < 0.01 (1 percentage point), dropped; k = cases with d > 0 of n non-ties; p = the exact binomial two-sided p at 1/2; holds when p < 0.05 and k > n - k
f_pass_rule.P3: rms of V3's Q2 error (% of D) < rms of N's, over the group A cases with Q2
f_pass_rule.P4: the P2 test on Q2 with ties |d| < 0.01 of D
f_pass_rule.pool: group A cases (E212 runs and E206/E207 points pooled)
f_pass_rule.verdict: PASS when P1, P2, P3 and P4 all hold; NOT DECIDED when either sign test has fewer than 6 non-tied cases; else FAIL (the failing conditions named). The same four are REPORTED against N2 and, where it applies, V1, and for E212 and E206/E207 apart; none of those enters the verdict.
